Pet travel notice

If you are bringing a pet on Aurelia Skyways, please check your travel plans with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you head to the airport. The desk helps travelers with calm, careful support and makes sure each animal is handled with patience.

Bird travelers need special attention. <<FACT F065>> Please also make sure the crate is secure, clean, and ready for a smooth check-in. If your pet seems uneasy, tell the staff right away so they can help with the next steps.

For a simple review of travel needs, use the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure. The staff can guide you through the details and keep the process easy.
